title: 大守护者

sync.scope: Source statistics tables and available 2026 history; base values

history.description: Added levels 81 to 85 Grand Warden. Reduced upgrade costs at levels 76 to 80. Elixir

facts: The Grand Warden is the fourth Hero unlocked at Hero Hall level 5, which requires Town Hall 11. He is a single-target unit with low health and relatively low damage, but he makes up for it with his long range and supporting abilities.
Upgrading the Blacksmith to level 4 and 6 unlocks the Rage Gem and Healing Tome respectively.
